title: Rebaseline the audit on a stable candidate
deliverable: Candidate commit/source hashes; refreshed finding register; actual owners and PR boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce or supersede each ACC finding against the chosen working revision; retain the old evidence. || Identify concurrent AP changes and distinguish existing fixes from remaining work. || Record named owners and exact test commands; do not copy audit defects blindly into implementation.

title: Freeze accounting and workflow contracts
deliverable: Versioned money, calendar, policy-change, source-ownership and close-state contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Declare supported base currencies, precision, rounding stage, business dates/timezone and fiscal boundaries. || Specify posting lock versus reviewed close versus certified export; classify allowed manual adjustments. || Define shared report/cache DTOs early enough to remove circular implementation dependencies.

title: Provision isolated verification and fixtures
deliverable: Disposable PostgreSQL database, real application role, two tenants, actor roles and reproducible financial fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: No production writes or seeded customer records. || Fixtures include cash/credit sales, AP, inventory, payroll, suspense, reversal, closed period and mixed-currency rejection. || Authenticated browser roles and concurrency barriers work; environment scripts are reviewed before execution.

title: Measure existing data exposure
deliverable: Read-only exposure report grouped by tenant, source, period and currency, with a repair classification.
acceptance_criteria: Scan currency/base inconsistencies, historical settings, generic source reversals, orphan/foreign references and overlapping periods. || Compare closed periods with source failures and assurance blockers. || Classify none found, confirmed affected, or access unavailable; unavailable is never treated as clean.

title: Enforce the supported currency scope
deliverable: Server-enforced currency admission and explicit unsupported/mixed-data report states.
acceptance_criteria: Every producer derives the correct supported organization/source currency instead of falling back silently to XAF. || Unsupported conversion fails explicitly; contaminated historical aggregates cannot appear trustworthy. || Existing settlement/correction obligations receive an explicit supported recovery path rather than a blanket dead end.

title: Protect material accounting settings
deliverable: Validated policy enums and a used/locked-setting mutation boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Direct actions and service calls reject prohibited base-currency, valuation and calendar mutations. || Before/after policy evidence is retained for permitted changes. || Any future effective-dated transition is separate from an unrestricted generic update.

title: Restrict generic reversal to valid sources
deliverable: Source-to-correction routing and guarded generic reversal.
acceptance_criteria: POS/AP/inventory/payroll/payment source types cannot bypass their owning correction command. || Legitimate manual adjustment and reversal semantics remain supported and traceable. || Current authorization, reason/date and source identity are validated; a UI-only restriction does not pass.

title: Correct misleading finance proof labels
deliverable: Truthful operational-versus-ledger labels and partial-source disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: Operational sales orders never receive a posted-ledger badge by assumption. || Heuristic confidence cannot produce certification. || Existing capped metrics are visibly partial until full-population aggregation is delivered in ACR-21.

title: Enforce tenant-safe ledger relationships and dimensions
deliverable: Constraint design, scoped dimension validation, migration preflight and invalid-reference report.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign or missing account/parent/customer/supplier/item/location references fail at the appropriate boundary. || Existing invalid references are investigated before constraints are validated. || Retention, cascade behavior and permitted historical dimension changes are documented.

title: Make posted financial content immutable
deliverable: Migration and privilege boundary for posted monetary content, with safe allowed transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Application-role SQL cannot mutate/delete protected posted financial content. || Valid multi-line posting and controlled reversal/status changes remain possible within one transaction. || Migration rehearsals include existing data, backup/restore, validation failure and rollback behavior.

title: Serialize posting, reversal and closing
deliverable: Shared period-lock order, atomic lifecycle claims, stable command identity and bounded retries.
acceptance_criteria: Real PostgreSQL tests cover post-versus-close, simultaneous reversal and ambiguous-commit retry. || Close acquires its boundary before preflight; writers use the compatible protocol. || Retries neither create an extra effect nor leave the caller with an unexplained result; deadlocks terminate predictably.

title: Correct fiscal boundaries and overlapping periods
deliverable: Calendar boundary fix and concurrent overlap protection.
acceptance_criteria: Short years, mid-month starts, leap dates and timezone cutoffs resolve correctly. || Each allowed date has the intended unambiguous period. || Existing posted calendar exceptions follow reviewed correction rather than silent reassignment.

title: Verify POS, refunds and offline replay against the kernel
deliverable: POS source-to-stock/tender/ledger reconciliation suite and owned recovery contract.
acceptance_criteria: Cash, credit, split tender, discounts/tax, refund/void and source cost effects reconcile. || Duplicate/offline replay and lost responses create one intended effect; changed payloads fail. || Shift-close evidence assertions match the intended event audit contract.

title: Verify purchasing/AP recognition and correction
deliverable: PO/receipt/invoice/payment/credit reconciliation matrix and validated posting recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Partial receipts and receipt/invoice timing differences have explicit clearing/exception ownership. || Posting replay verifies source hashes and existing effects; preparation correction cannot alter posted obligations. || Supplier payment, return and credit corrections reconcile to source, subledger and GL.

title: Verify inventory valuation and corrections
deliverable: Valuation/COGS/source-movement reconciliation with adjustment and reversal proof.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt/issue/transfer/reservation semantics preserve owned-stock meaning. || Backdating and negative-stock behavior are either policy-valid and tested or explicitly blocked. || Write-off/adjustment/reversal and source currency reconcile to class-3 accounts and close evidence.

title: Verify payroll, settlement and suspense integrations
deliverable: Payroll/AR/payment/suspense reconciliation cases and current evidence boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Approved payroll liabilities and later payments/corrections reconcile without exposing person-level data to unauthorized readers. || Customer allocation, provider evidence, fees/suspense and partial matching cannot double-consume a source amount. || Country/provider applicability is explicit; unavailable external evidence blocks only the capability that depends on it.

title: Unify close blockers and evidence freshness
depends_on: ACR-10; ACR-11; ACR-12; ACR-13; ACR-14; ACR-15; ACR-17
deliverable: Shared close readiness contract including unassigned failures and applicable module evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory/payroll/AP/payment blockers govern the policy-defined reviewed-close transition. || Late source changes invalidate affected evidence and exports; current evidence is rechecked at action time. || Locked, closed, reviewed and certified states remain distinct and existing stronger pack controls are preserved.

title: Harden event conflict recovery and operational ownership
deliverable: Resolved event-test contract drift, replay runbook and failure/age signals.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory conflict testing proves durable conflict evidence and no stock mutation, including evidence-write failure. || Outbox duplicate, stale lease, retry exhaustion and changed-payload cases retain a recoverable state. || Each pending/failed source has an owner and a documented recovery action.

title: Define one financial report and cache contract
deliverable: DTO contract for currency, scope, opening/activity/closing, as-of version, completeness and access identity.
acceptance_criteria: P&L activity and cumulative balance sheet use explicit different windows. || Paging, aggregate totals, stable ordering and source proof meanings are defined before implementation. || Cache identity includes every result-changing filter and access scope; no dependency on finished UI is required.

title: Correct report monetary and balance semantics
deliverable: Correct GL opening/activity/closing, currency aggregation and exact decimal serialization.
acceptance_criteria: Opening plus activity equals closing for debit/credit accounts, including cross-period reversal. || Mixed unsupported currency is rejected or safely partitioned under the approved policy. || TB, GL, statements and exact exports agree; archived posted accounts and contra-account signs remain correct.

title: Bound reporting work and preserve snapshot consistency
deliverable: SQL totals, cursor details, consistent report version and benchmark evidence.
acceptance_criteria: 100k-line fixtures and the measured pilot tenant envelope meet agreed latency/payload budgets. || Concurrent posting cannot produce an internally inconsistent report snapshot. || Pagination/streaming maintains ordering and totals; any summary rebuild reconciles to the ledger.

title: Correct full-population finance metrics
deliverable: Ledger/operational metric separation, uncapped totals and source-backed labels.
acceptance_criteria: More than 250 source rows produce complete totals or an explicit unavailable/partial state. || Recognized revenue, COGS, expenses and cash movements retain distinct definitions. || Proof labels derive from evidence state, not a heuristic score or the absence of an overdue item.

title: Implement scoped cache and mutation invalidation
deliverable: Scoped key factories, cache eviction and a cross-module invalidation matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Two tenants, different limits and changed permission/consent versions never reuse protected results. || Logout without reload, revocation and session changes remove stale protected cache. || Posting, reversal, payment, reconciliation and close refresh all affected mounted views.

title: Complete safe accountant UI and localized formatting
deliverable: Correct currency/decimal display, server totals/paging, visible stale/error states and reviewed financial actions.
acceptance_criteria: More than 100 journals remain discoverable; count scope is accurate. || Invalid/missing/stale values cannot look like current certified zeroes. || English/French desktop/mobile and keyboard/screen-reader flows show source, date, amount and action consequences.

title: Rehearse and reconcile any required data repair
depends_on: ACR-03; ACR-04; ACR-05; ACR-09; ACR-10; ACR-11; ACR-12; ACR-13; ACR-14; ACR-15; ACR-16; ACR-19; ACR-21
deliverable: Tenant-scoped repair packet or verified no-repair disposition; rehearsal reconciliation and rollback proof.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected record has source evidence, proposed correction, reviewer and before/after reconciliation. || Preserve original posted history; use owned corrections/adjustments or a reviewed migration design. || Estimate is for packet/rehearsal only; unknown-volume live repair is separately estimated and blocks affected tenants from pilot.

title: Prove the release candidate end to end
depends_on: ACR-16; ACR-17; ACR-20; ACR-21; ACR-23; ACR-24
deliverable: Candidate-specific verification packet and a deployment/rollback rehearsal.
acceptance_criteria: Affected regression suites are green; direct endpoint, real DB concurrency and authenticated UI tests cover the repaired findings. || Installed constraints/privileges match the candidate; backup/restore and deploy failure are rehearsed. || No unresolved high-risk finding remains in the proposed release scope; unsupported statutory/provider/FX capabilities stay explicitly gated.

title: Pilot the correction set with close observation
deliverable: Bounded tenant pilot, daily reconciliation dashboard and observed close cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Start with one eligible tenant/scope, then expand to 3–5 only after the first gate remains clean. || Observe at least ten business days and one complete close/reconciliation cycle; use a longer window if the real close calendar requires it. || Unexplained mismatch, duplicate effect, closed-period write or tenant leak stops expansion and invokes the incident plan.

title: Close findings and expand within proven scope
deliverable: Accepted finding evidence, residual-scope register, release decision and support handover.
acceptance_criteria: Each ACC finding is verified fixed, no longer reproducible with proof, or outside the explicitly restricted release scope. || Data repair, runbooks, owners and pilot results are attached to the exact released revision. || Completion is evidence-based; neither code merged nor a percentage-complete dashboard alone closes a financial control.
